evidence.quote: the data is \"JxA=\", which converts to 10000. In that field's schema, there is also a scale parameter ... in your event use case that scale would be 2, so that you arrive at 100.00.

notes: DECIMAL is emitted as Connect Decimal (big-endian unscaled bytes + scale in schema) by design; consumer decoded it wrongly (C# little-endian BigInteger). decimal.handling.mode code settles it.
